blurb:
Discover Midtown Atlanta Through Food, History, and Art

Experience the vibrant heart of Atlanta on this guided walking food tour through Midtown. Sample delicious bites from multiple locally loved restaurants, ranging from classic Southern comfort to global flavors. Along the way, your guide will share the rich history of the neighborhood, its hidden gems, and stories of the people who shaped it. Admire Midtown’s striking architecture and public art as you stroll between tastings. It’s the perfect blend of culture, cuisine, and city charm—come hungry and leave inspired.
